selected_filter_input.selection_semantics: one string or null per axis; AND across axes; omitted/null/unknown ignored; lists and numeric enum values rejected
selected_filter_input.metadata_values: canonical v1 per-form strings; case-insensitive exact tokens; no numeric client enum mapping at runtime
selected_filter_input.selected_observed_conflict: ignore both values on that axis and record issue; full-catalog illustration guard remains authoritative
selected_filter_input.input_source: explicit user selection only; target discovery values removed without request input
selected_filter_input.frontend_status: not wired in this backend slice

candidate_policy.conservative_unknown_exception: any unknown used DB field retains the entire form even if another known used field mismatches; joint output need not equal the intersection of per-axis diagnostic sets
candidate_policy.metadata_sources: generated runtime per-form overrides and canonical catalog must agree
candidate_policy.retained_uncertain_form: eligible for search, never positive evidence for attribute-based form confirmation
candidate_policy.empty_intersection: full catalog fallback; record proposed count zero
candidate_policy.singleton: no identity vote; finite conditional margin, full illustration guard required
candidate_policy.names: base id retained when any form remains; explicit allowed_student_refs passed to match/compare
candidate_policy.illustrations: canonical form refs mapped to raw template identities; explicit allowed_identities passed to match

authority.source: existing full-catalog illustration identity or confirmed full-catalog base plus unique form attributes
authority.reduced_candidate_margin: diagnostic only; never substitutes for full-catalog illustration margin
authority.excluded_confident_global_winner: return existing full-catalog illustration identity; revert name search to full catalog; record contradiction
authority.unconfirmed_global_base_or_form: no identity; bounded recapture then identity_unconfirmed

evidence_schema.compatibility: additive fields; all old keys, margin numerics, fallback_reason latest alias and decision behavior retained
evidence_schema.runner_exists: boolean for scored production match; null for legacy injected or unscored unavailable results
evidence_schema.runner_margin: null without a distinct scored runner; otherwise the actual current two-candidate difference; never replaces legacy margin
evidence_schema.axis_candidates: independent single-axis match-or-unknown sets with refs/count/hash; ignored axes keep the full set
evidence_schema.axis_intersection_refs: ordinary intersection of diagnostic single-axis sets, not the conservative joint decision
evidence_schema.conservative_override_refs: forms retained by unknown used metadata despite exclusion by another single-axis set
evidence_schema.proposed_refs: actual conservative joint result before empty-intersection fallback; empty list and hash are preserved
evidence_schema.initial_fallback_reason: candidate construction phase reason; never overwritten by identity phase
evidence_schema.final_fallback_reason: latest fallback reason; legacy fallback_reason retains this meaning
evidence_schema.fallback_history: ordered candidate/identity phase reasons with details
evidence_schema.application: initial/final candidate filter flags and per-axis initial/latest reasons; portrait_filter_applied records actual restricted search even after full fallback

evaluation.full_catalog_C0_C5_C6_C7_results: historical separate; unchanged frozen trials are not relabeled or adopted
evaluation.new_engine_gate: none; no engine claim or threshold change
